level.title: Marathi C1+ — Poetry, story, review
goals: Read a Marathi poem aloud and speak about its रस, अलंकार and ओळ
Follow a story through its characters, structure and style
Write a short review with a clearly named standpoint and no prejudice

lessons.title: कविता वाचणे
lessons.learn: A poem is कविता, its lines ओळी, its metre छंद and its aesthetic flavour रस. Marathi criticism names nine रस and speaks of अलंकार as the figures that carry them.

grammar.title: Speaking about a poem
grammar.pattern: या कवितेत करुण रस आहे · ओळीचा छंद सुटत नाही · अलंकार ओळखा
grammar.explain: रस and अलंकार are masculine and take आहे; कविता and ओळ are feminine. A poem is read वाचली जाते or recited म्हटली जाते, and a line that carries a figure is described with -ने: उपमेने.

examples.en: There is the flavour of pathos in this poem.
There is a simile in three lines.
The poem is read aloud.

dialogue.en: How did this poem seem to you?

dialogue.t: छंद घट्ट आहे आणि शेवटच्या ओळीत करुण रस आहे.
dialogue.r: Chhand ghatt ahe aani shevtachya olinit karun ras ahe.
dialogue.en: The metre is firm and there is pathos in the last line.
Which figure is there?

dialogue.t: उपमा. ती ओळ मोठ्याने वाचली तर चांगली लागते.
dialogue.r: Upma. Ti ol mothyanne vaachli tar chaangli lagte.
dialogue.en: A simile. That line sounds good read aloud.

lessons.title: रूपक आणि प्रतिमा
lessons.learn: उपमा compares with सारखा, रूपक identifies outright, and प्रतिमा is the image the line builds. A figure of sound is अनुप्रास, and the implicit suggestion is ध्वनि.

grammar.title: Naming the figure
grammar.pattern: … सारखा वाटतो (उपमा) · … च आहेच (रूपक) · अनुप्रास ओळीत ऐकू येतो
grammar.explain: उपमा keeps the two things apart with सारखा/प्रमाणे, while रूपक fuses them: चंद्र सारखा चेहरा is a simile and चेहराच चंद्र is a metaphor. ध्वनि is what the line suggests beyond what it says — the point Marathi criticism cares about most.

examples.en: The face is like the moon.
A mother's love is like shade.
There is alliteration in this line.

mistakes.why: With सारखी it stays a simile: सावलीसारखी.

dialogue.t: ही ओळ रूपक आहे की उपमा?
dialogue.r: Hi ol rupak ahe ki upma?
dialogue.en: Is this line a metaphor or a simile?

dialogue.t: उपमा, कारण सारखी हा शब्द आहे.
dialogue.r: Upma, karan saarkhi ha shabd ahe.
dialogue.en: A simile, because the word 'like' is there.
Then where is the metaphor?

dialogue.t: पुढच्या ओळीत, जिथे प्रतिमाच माणूस होते.
dialogue.r: Pudchya olit, jithe pratimach maanus hote.
dialogue.en: In the next line, where the image itself becomes a person.

lessons.title: कवितेचा अर्थ लावणे
lessons.learn: Interpretation runs on संदर्भ (context) and भावार्थ (sense); a hasty reading is अर्थ लावणे done गडबडीत. सूचित means suggested, and the settled reading is अर्थ स्पष्ट होतो.

grammar.title: Reading with context
grammar.pattern: संदर्भाशिवाय अर्थ लागत नाही · यातून सूचित होते · व्याख्या करताना
grammar.explain: संदर्भाशिवाय (without context) and व्याख्या करताना (while interpreting) are the two fixed phrases of this lesson. सूचित होते states what the text implies, and भावार्थ is the sense you are entitled to claim — not the sense you invent.

examples.t: संदर्भाशिवाय या ओळीचा अर्थ लागत नाही.
examples.r: Sandarbhashivay ya olicha arth laagat nahi.
examples.en: Without context this line cannot be interpreted.
Despair is suggested by this line.
While interpreting, give the context.

mistakes.why: The point is the negation: without context the sense does not come.
The impersonal सूचित होते is neuter.

dialogue.en: What does this line mean?
Without context it cannot be interpreted.
And if the context is given?

dialogue.t: तर हताशा सूचित होते, पण असा व्याख्या केला तर गडबड होईल.
dialogue.r: Tar hataasha suchit hote, pan asa vyakhya kela tar gadbad hoil.
dialogue.en: Then despair is suggested, but to interpret it that way would be hasty.

lessons.title: पात्र आणि वाटचाल
lessons.learn: In a story the character is पात्र and the arc वाटचाल; the inner conflict is द्वंद्व and the turning point कलाटणी. पात्र is neuter, वाटचाल and कलाटणी are feminine.

grammar.title: Following a character
grammar.pattern: पात्राची वाटचाल विश्वासार्ह वाटते · द्वंद्व कमी होत नाही · कलाटणीत काय बदलते?
grammar.explain: The character's course is पात्राची वाटचाल and it वाटते विश्वासार्ह or ठोस, while the conflict कमी होते. The turning point is asked about with कलाटणीत काय बदलले? — the reliable test of a story's structure.

examples.en: The character's arc seems believable.
The story's conflict does not ease.
At the turning point the character's decision changes.

lessons.title: कथानकाची रचना
lessons.learn: Plot is कथानक and structure रचना; an episode is प्रसंग and the thread सूत्र. उत्कटता is the intensity and कालानुक्रम the time order. A plot that moves back and forth has कालानुक्रम मोडला आहे, and उत्कटता वाढते where the turns are placed well.

grammar.title: Describing structure
grammar.pattern: कथानक घट्ट आहे · प्रसंग मागेपुढे केले आहेत · उत्कटता वाढते

examples.en: The structure of the plot is firm.
The author has broken the chronological order.
In the second part the intensity rises.

dialogue.en: How is the plot's structure?

lessons.title: शैली आणि भाषा
lessons.learn: Style is शैली and the local speech a writer uses is बोली; sentence craft is वाक्यरचना and the idiom of a region म्हणी. Shorter sentences are described as कोरडी or तरल.

grammar.title: Talking about style
grammar.pattern: लेखकाची शैली ओळखता येते · बोलीतले शब्द वापरले आहेत · वाक्यरचना तरल आहे

examples.en: The writer's style is recognisable in the first paragraph itself.

lessons.title: मूल्यमापन
lessons.learn: To review is मूल्यमापन करणे; the judgement is न्याय and the standard मापदंड. निष्पक्ष means even-handed, and पक्षपात partiality. The reviewer states the yardstick first and then judges: मापदंड स्पष्ट असावा, अन्यथा न्याय होत नाही.

grammar.title: Judging a work
grammar.pattern: मूल्यमापन करताना मापदंड स्पष्ट असावा · न्याय करणे सोपे नाही · पक्षपात टाळावा
grammar.explain: The review states its standard with मापदंड स्पष्ट असावा and its verdict with न्याय करताना …. पक्षपात टाळावा (one must avoid partiality) is the reviewer's own rule, and it uses the optative -ावा.

examples.en: While evaluating, the standard should be clear.

examples.t: पक्षपात टाळावा, अन्यथा न्याय होत नाही.
examples.r: Pakshpat taalava, anyatha nyay hot nahi.
examples.en: Partiality must be avoided, otherwise there is no judgement.
An impartial review gives the reader confidence.

mistakes.why: मापदंड here is singular masculine: असावा.

dialogue.en: Are you ready to write the review?
Yes, but the standard should be clear.
Which standard will you take?

dialogue.t: भाषेचा आणि रचनेचा — आणि पक्षपात टाळावा.
dialogue.r: Bhashecha aani rachanecha — aani pakshpat taalava.
dialogue.en: That of language and structure — and partiality must be avoided.

lessons.title: समीक्षा लिहिणे
lessons.learn: A review moves in four steps: परिचय, मुद्दे, पुरावा, निष्कर्ष. समीक्षा is feminine and निष्कर्ष masculine, and a citation is संदर्भ द्यावा. The order matters: परिचय first, then the मुद्दे, an उद्धरण for each, and the निष्कर्ष last.

grammar.explain: The steps take the imperative: परिचय द्या, मुद्दे द्या, उद्धरण द्या, निष्कर्ष काढा. A shortcoming is noted with तोटा आहे, and the last line carries the निष्कर्ष — without the applause that belongs to a different genre.

culture.text: Marathi has one of the oldest literatures among the modern Indian languages. Dnyaneshwari (1290) — ज्ञानेश्वरी — put philosophy into the verse and images of ordinary Marathi speech, Tukaram's abhangas turned it into song, and the Peshwa centuries produced पोवाडे, the ballads of the battlefield. Then came the modern turn: the novel, the short story, and the theatre of Vijay Tendulkar. A learner who reads one abhanga and one page of modern prose has touched both ends of seven hundred years.

reading.text: समीक्षेत पहिला नियम असा: मापदंड आधी सांगावा. दुसरा नियम — प्रत्येक मुद्द्याला उद्धरण द्यावे, कारण दावा पुराव्याशिवाय उभा राहत नाही. तिसरा नियम — कादंबरीचा काळ आणि समाज समजून घ्यावा; संदर्भाशिवाय अर्थ लागत नाही. या पुस्तकात शैली तरल आहे आणि स्त्री-पात्रांची वाटचाल विश्वासार्ह आहे. दुसऱ्या भागाची उत्कटता वाढते, पण शेवटच्या प्रकरणात कालानुक्रम मोडल्याने काही वाचक बुचकळ्यात पडतात. निष्कर्ष: चांगले पुस्तक, पण शेवट जास्त स्पष्ट असावा.
reading.gloss: In a review the first rule is: state the standard first. The second rule — back every point with a quotation, because a claim cannot stand without evidence. The third rule — understand the novel's period and society; without context the sense does not come. In this book the style is fluid and the arc of the women characters is believable. In the second part the intensity rises, but because the chronological order is broken in the last chapter some readers get bewildered. Conclusion: a good book, but the ending should be clearer.
